derivation: or מָזֹר; from H2115 (זוּר) in the sense of binding up;
def: a bandage, i.e. remedy; hence, a sore (as needing a compress)

words.word: that thou mayest be bound up

occurrences.text: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
words: that thou mayest be bound up

occurrences.text: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
